card.summary: Free limits: uploads up to 5000 MB, 10000 GB of storage, files deleted 90 days after the last download; playback has no bandwidth limits.

free_tier.stated: Free limits: uploads up to 5000 MB, 10000 GB of storage, files deleted 90 days after the last download; playback has no bandwidth limits.

per_object_cap.stated: 5000 MB per file on Free; 30000 MB on Premium

retention.stated: 90 days after the last download on Free; 365 days on Premium

egress.terms: Playback has no bandwidth limits; Premium is sold for a fixed number of days with no automatic renewal, and bandwidth packs cover traffic served to viewers.

record.interface_detail: Uploads by browser, FTP, remote URL or the API are stated on the home page; Premium adds torrent upload.
record.tooling: Browser, FTP, remote URL upload and an API (per the home page FAQ).
record.chaining: Premium is bought for a fixed number of days and raises uploads to 30000 MB and unlimited storage; the price list is not on the pages read.

limits.value: 5000 MB per file on Free, 30000 MB on Premium
10000 GB of storage on Free, Unlimited on Premium
files are deleted 90 days after the last download on Free, 365 days on Premium

record.binding_note: A 5000 MB file ceiling is the first limit; the 10000 GB storage is far above any other free figure.

identity_cost.detail: The premium page states that Premium is attached to a Uqload account and that a free account is created first; the form fields were not read.

record.reliability_note: The vendor serves the same site on more than one domain (uqload.is and uqload.vc).
record.confidence_note: Limits read on the vendor premium page. Cheapest paid tier: unverified: the plan prices are not in the captured text of the premium page.
